facts.text: San Luis Obispo was founded by Spanish missionary Junípero Serra on September 1, 1772, establishing Mission San Luis Obispo de Tolosa.
The town’s name honors Louis, bishop of Toulouse, whose Spanish title “Luis, obispo de Tolosa” inspired both the mission and city names.
San Luis Obispo hosts California Polytechnic State University, a leading engineering school that attracts students nationwide.
The historic Madonna Inn, opened in 1958 by Alex Madonna, is a quirky landmark known for its themed rooms and eccentric décor.
The Fremont Theater, a 1940s Art Deco cinema, now stages live performances and preserves mid‑century movie‑theater architecture.
The San Luis Obispo Historical Society, located beside the mission, curates rotating exhibits on the city’s more than 180 historic buildings.
